'''Spices''' were a substance used to season [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]]. [[Black hole pepper]], [[Boontaspice/Legends|boontaspice]], [[kessinnamon]], [[negamo]], [[punctil]], and [[Tigmary/Legends|tigmary]] were all varieties of spices uses at the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Menu" />
